senses.gloss: गन्ध- + इभ गन्ध- + इभ, m. a kind of elephant, Rājat. 1, 300.
गन्ध- + उपजीविन् गन्ध- + उपजीविन्, adj. trading with perfumes, Rām. 2, 83, 14.

गन्तृ गन्तृ, i. e. गम् + तृ, m., f. त्री, n.
 1. One who goes, MBh. 13, 7173.
 2. Able to go, Nal. 24, 38.
 3. Undergoing, Yājñ. 3, 10.
 --Cf. Lat. in-ventor.

† गन्ध् गन्ध्, i. 10, Ātm.
 1. To injure.
 2. To move.
 3. To ask.

गन्ध गन्ध, m.
 1. Smell, odour, Hiḍ. 2, 12.
 2. A perfume, Man. 2, 177.
 3. A name of Śiva, MBh. 12, 10378.
 --Comp.
गन्धकालिका गन्धकालिका, i. e. गन्ध-काली + क, f. A proper name, MBh. 1, 3801.
गन्धप गन्ध-प, m. A class of Pitṛs or Manes, MBh. 13, 1372.

गन्धमादन गन्धमादन, i. e. गन्ध-मद्, Caus., + अन, m.
 1. The name of a mountain, Rām. 2, 54, 28.
 2. A name of Rāvaṇa, MBh. 2, 410.
 3. The name of a monkey, Rām. 1, 16, 13.

गन्धर्व गन्धर्व, and र्ब र्ब,
 I. m. A Gandharva: in epic poetry the Gandharvas are demigods inhabiting Indra's heaven, and serving as celestial musicians, MBh. 1, 4806.
 II. f. वी.
 1. A female Gandharva, Bhāg. P. 4, 29, 21.
 2. A mythological person, Rām. 3, 20, 28; 29.
 --Comp.

गान्धर्व गान्धर्व, i. e. गन्धर्व + अ,
 I. adj., f. वी.
 1. Referable or belonging to the Gandharvas, MBh. 7, 6348; Rām. 1, 29, 15.
 2. m. viz. विवाह, A form of marriage, that which requires only mutual agreement, Man. 3, 21.
 3. Musical, MBh. 3, 8421.
 4. Possessed by the Gandharvas, Suśr. 1, 332, 21.
 II. n. Music and dance, MBh. 13, 1427.
 --Comp.

गन्धवन्त् गन्ध + वन्त्,
 I. adj., f. वती, Fragrant, Rām. 6, 112, 84.
 II. f. वती,
 1. A name of Vyāsa's mother, MBh. i, 2411.
 2. The name of a river, Megh. 34.

गन्धवह गन्ध-वह,
 I. adj., f. हा, Conveying fragrance, Bhāg. P. 2, 10, 20.
 II. m. The wind, Śāk. d. 101.
गन्ध- + वाह गन्ध- + वाह, m. the wind, Gīt. 1, 35.
गन्धार गन्धार, m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 1, 2440.

गान्धार गान्धार, i. e.
 I. गान्धारि + अ,
 1. m. A prince of the Gāndhāris.
 2. f. री, A princess of the Gāndhāris, MBh. 1, 3790.
 II. m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 6, 361.
 III. m. The third note of the scale, MBh. 4, 515.

ऽगन्धि -गन्धि, A substitute for गन्ध, when the latter part of a comp. e. g. उत्पल-, adj. Smelling like lotus flowers, Rām. 5, 5, 12.
 उद्-, adj. Fragrant, Ragh. 16, 47.
 त्रि-सु-, n. The three perfumes, Suśr. 2, 483, 9.
 दुस्-, adj. Having no agreeable smell, Man. 6, 76.
 पुण्य-, adj. Having a fragrant smell, Chr. 34, 6.
 पूति-, adj. Stinking, MBh. 2, 2138.
 वि-, adj. Having a disagreeable smell, Bhartṛ. 2, 9.
 सु-,
 I. adj.
 1. Fragrant.
 2. Virtuous.
 II. m.
 1. A perfume.
 2. A fragrant sort of mango.
 III. n. The name of several plants.

ऽगन्धिक -गन्धि + क, latter part of a comp.
 1. Smelling,
 2. Having only the smell of, e. g. भ्रातृ-, adj. Being a brother only nominally, not really, MBh. 3, 16111.
 --Comp.

गान्धिक गान्धिक, i. e. गन्ध + इक, []
 I. m. A vendor of perfumes, Sāh. D. 35, 11.
 II. n. Perfumes, Pañc. 7, 17.

गन्धिन् गन्धिन्, i. e. गन्ध + इन्, adj., f. नी, Fragrant, MBh. 14, 1398. []
 --Comp.
गान गान, i. e. गै + न, n. A song, Śiś. 9, 54.

गान्धारि गान्धारि,
 1. m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 8, 2135.
 2. i. e. गान्धारी + इ, metronym. The sor of Gāndhārī, MBh. 2, 1791.
गन्ध- + जल गन्ध- + जल, f. ला, fragrant water, Bhāg. P. 1, 11, 15.
गन्ध- + तैल गन्ध- + तैल, n. oil prepared with perfumes, Rām. 4, 24, 16.
गन्ध- + द्विप गन्ध- + द्विप, m. a very strong kind of elephant, Vikr. d. 156.
गन्धर्व-नगर गन्धर्व-नगर, n. 1. the city of the Gandharvas, MBh. 2, 1043. 2. the fata morgana, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 5.
गन्धर्व-पुर गन्धर्व-पुर, n. a mirage, Bhāg. P. 5, 13, 3.

गन्ध- + पुष्प गन्ध- + पुष्प,
 I. n. a fragrant flower.
 II. m. the name of several plants.
गन्ध- + माल्य गन्ध- + माल्य, n. an agreeably smelling wreath, Pañc. 182, 10.
गन्ध- + रस गन्ध- + रस, m. myrrh, MBh. 5, 777.
गन्धर्व- + वेद गन्धर्व- + वेद, m. the science of music.
गान्धर्व- + शाला गान्धर्व- + शाला, f. a music-room, Kathās. 12, 31.
गन्ध- + हस्तिन् गन्ध- + हस्तिन्, m. a kind of elephant (in rut?), Rām. 5, 73, 26.
